verdict.rationale: Moss documents official SDKs across many languages: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript (Node `@moss-js/moss`), Swift, Elixir, C, and a WASM browser build. The docs include a per-class JS API reference (MossClient) and SDK-specific features such as disk caching and `minScore` filtering, and the first-party GitHub repo backs this up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work as documented, since all evidence is vendor-authored.
